definitions.explanation: The audible sound of someone laughing. Focuses on the sound itself rather than the act of laughing.

examples.japanese: {笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
{子|こ}どもたち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: Children's laughter echoed through the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漏|も}れて→漏れる：02435_moreru⟧きて、⟦{気|き}になって→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: Loud laughter was coming from the next room, and it bothered me so much I couldn't sleep.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧ (laughing) and ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (voice/sound), where ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ becomes {声|ごえ} through rendaku. This word emphasizes the audible aspect of laughter — what you hear — rather than the facial expression or the act of laughing itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: to hear laughter
- {笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧: laughter echoes/rings out
- {笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to raise a laugh, to burst out laughing
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}: loud laughter
- {笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: can't stop laughing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧: laughter, a laugh — the act or fact of laughing, broader than the sound
- ⟦{哄笑|こうしょう}→哄笑：24178_koushou⟧: roar of laughter — literary, describing loud group laughter
- ⟦{微笑|びしょう}→微笑：08687_bishou⟧: smile — visual rather than audible

RELATED PATTERNS:
The ～{声|ごえ} pattern creates many sound-related nouns: {泣|な}き{声|ごえ} (crying sound), ⟦{叫|さけ}び{声|ごえ}→叫び声：26924_sakebigoe⟧ (shout), ⟦{話|はな}し{声|ごえ}→話し声：29481_hanashigoe⟧ (speaking voice).
